checks.lead: Prince Gustaf Adolf of Sweden, Duke of Västerbotten (Gustaf Adolf Oscar Fredrik Arthur Edmund; 22 April 1906 – 26 January 1947) was a Swedish prince who for most of his life was second in the line of succession to the Swedish throne with the title of Hereditary Prince.
